firm_data.firm_description: Ettinger Law Firm is a New York estate planning attorney firm that provides elder law services, including living trusts, asset protection trusts, medicaid applications, wills, probate, estate administration, and special needs trusts. They have over 34 years of experience and offer free consultations.
notable_facts: Ettinger Law Firm has served over thirty thousand satisfied clients since 1991
The firm has a trademarked “Lifetime Estate Planning Process”
The firm has twelve offices in New York

email.subject: AI for Ettinger Law Firm, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Michael,

Thirty thousand clients served since 1991 is a remarkable testament to Ettinger's reputation in elder law and estate planning. That scale demands systems that protect client trust while keeping your team efficient.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in the Albany region to meet firms managing complex Medicaid and probate workflows. I'd be happy to stop by your office to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
